description: Look at the cube in use mode
expected: The front face fills the screen: xp with sunset and chora windows, a STEP BACK Alt+Esc chip

description: Press Alt+Escape (step back)
expected: The camera steps back: the whole face shows with chips TURN LEFT, TURN RIGHT, STEP IN

description: Look at the floating windows
expected: The windows float in front of the face on their own planes

description: Press Ctrl+Alt+Right (turn by key), look mid-turn
expected: The cube starts to turn to the next face

description: Wait for the turn to end
expected: The next face (desktop 2: wobbly.rs and load) stands in front

description: Drag that starts on a floating window (load), from right to left
expected: The cube turns (or the window moves)

description: Look at the face after that drag
expected: Either the face turned or the window moved on the face

description: Drag that starts on the empty desktop (top right), right to left
expected: The cube follows the drag and turns to the next face

description: Wait for the turn to settle
expected: Face 3 (cube.rs and chart) stands in front

description: Move the pointer off the face, then onto it
expected: The edge of the face lights when the pointer is over it

description: Move onto the face
expected: The edge of the face is lit

description: Click the TURN LEFT chip
expected: The cube turns back one face

description: Press Ctrl+Alt+Left (turn back)
expected: The cube is on the first face again (sunset, chora)

description: Click the face to step in
expected: The camera goes into the face: the xp desktop at 1:1 with the STEP BACK chip

description: Press Alt+Escape (step back again)
expected: The camera steps back from the face

description: Glide the camera to a view from the side
expected: The face seen at an angle, windows on it

description: Drag the title bar of the sunset window off the face
expected: The window leaves the face and becomes a pane in the space, with the label SUNSET

description: Wait for the pane to settle
expected: The pane floats beside the face, the taskbar button of sunset is gone

description: Super-drag the pane back onto the face
expected: While dragged the pane moves over the face

description: Wait after the drop
expected: The pane is an xp window again on the face, its task button is back
